name: Do I need a permit to widen a doorway in my Bay Area home?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to widen a doorway in my Bay Area home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a permit is required to widen a doorway depends on the scope of the project and local building codes in Bay Area cities like Pacifica or Daly City. Widening a doorway in a load-bearing wall almost always requires a permit because it involves structural modifications. Even some non-load-bearing wall modifications might require a permit if they affect electrical wiring or plumbing. Our team can help determine permit requirements and assist with the application process.
acceptedAnswer.description: A permit is usually needed for widening doorways in load-bearing walls due to structural changes. Some non-load-bearing modifications might also require a permit if utilities are affected.
